race.description: Racing@ Pinjarra Park Alcoa Cup 06/12 Hcp (C1)
race.comment: COSMO RULER (7) is a lightly raced mare with some upside, winning two back as a short favourite here before a 2.1L defeat at Bunbury last time out. Pike hops back on board today and she lands here off a short freshen. Can get the train back on the tracks and work through her grades. CAWARRA (10) disappointed last start at Belmont in Saturday company following two good efforts prior. Now out to 1300m again, though Brad Parnham hops on board. Can put herself in the right spot and will take beating if she's at her best. RADIANT LIGHT (5) disappointed last start as the equal fave, though the form out of his recent efforts has stood up. Now draws the inside for Riordan and a forward showing is on the cards. CABLE ROCK (11) missed narrowly last start at a big price and can't be discounted. ASTONISHER (8) can resume on a positive note.
